description: Database on cargo flows in the port of Rotterdam, 1880-2000 Goederenoverslag Rotterdamse haven, 1880-2000 is a data set deposited in DANS Data Stations by its authors Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam dr F.M.M. Goey, Erasmus School of History, Culture and Communication-ESHCC. p This dataset was created for the research project: Rotterdam-Antwerp, a century and a half of port competition, 1880-2000. The aim of the project was to investigate different variables that influence competition between these ports and their overall effect on cargo flows. This dataset only contains statistics on Rotterdam. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2003. Formats: ZIP, XML, Excel. Size stated: 63551. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is restricted according to the metadata; the conditions were not read. The licence is DANS Licence. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-dans-repository.
